harbor.reason: Paragraph excerpts now retain complete cause and calibration condition.

quill.reason: Baseline misses approval support and mislabels status; candidate repeats overlapping request spans and saves no draft.

decision: Keep internal v11, no default/preview promotion. Improved attached support is offset by an availability regression on the conflict case. Real diagnostic remains separate.
limitations: Six small synthetic cases and one seed; not a general benchmark.
Three relevant source documents per case do not stress retrieval caps.
Fixture-supplied plans, not autonomous planning or owner confirmation.
Multiple mechanisms changed together; no isolated causal attribution.
Required/forbidden rubric does not include every extra claim or status concern; those are retained in assessments.
